title: Balance patch v15 — NPC ally buffs

changes.before: Roles were flavor text (Brute/Ranger/Cleric…) with one flat stat curve for everyone
changes.after: Real roles: Tank (Ember, Mira), Healer (Anselm), DPS (everyone else) — shown as badges in the Party tab
changes.note: Pre-v15 allies are migrated to the new stats automatically on load.

changes.before: Max HP +20/level, defense +1/level — allies died in 1–2 hits past mid-game
changes.after: Max HP now scales exponentially with companion level (1.075^level × role multiplier + flat/level), plus role damage-taken: Tank 35%, Healer 55%, DPS 60%
changes.note: Example at Lv 60: Mira (Tank) 1,340 → 26,357 HP taking 35% damage; Lyra (DPS) 1,250 → 7,464 HP taking 60% damage.

changes.before: Anselm only regenerated its own HP
changes.after: Healer mends the PLAYER for 10% of player max HP every 8s during dungeon combat (light personal damage: 0.8×)
changes.note: Only heals when the player is hurt; never overheals.
Example at Lv 60: Mira 211 → ~405 per hit.

changes.after: +6 attack/level and 2.0× strike damage (glass cannon: lower HP, 60% damage taken)
changes.note: Example at Lv 60: Lyra 187 → ~728 per hit (~3.9×).

changes.before: 70 (briefly 120 on 2026-09-27, moved back to 70 before this raise)
changes.after: 90 everywhere: XP gains, GM level/XP grants, save validation [1,90], rebirth unlocks at 90
changes.note: Saves above 90 clamp down to 90 on load. Rebirth still resets to level 1.

changes.after: The same 1.42 exponent continues through 61–90 — no new kink
changes.note: Total XP 1→90 is ~37.25T (vs ~33.93B for 1→70). Levels 71–90 are the new endgame grind.

changes.before: No party system — XP came from race/gear/rested multipliers only
changes.after: +8% XP per other ONLINE human party member (max +24%), +4% XP per own NPC ally (max +12%)
changes.note: Only online members count, so parked alt accounts grant nothing. Applies to kill XP.

changes.after: +5% gold per other ONLINE human party member (max +15%)
changes.note: Applies to kill gold. NPC allies grant no gold bonus.

changes.after: Capped at +40% inside XP gains (tooltips still show the true total)
changes.note: Modest offset for the new party XP income; only affects heavily-forged XP gear. Cutting the kill-XP growth rate instead would have been a ~14x nuke at high stages.

changes.after: 1.30 exponent for levels 1–60, then 1.42 for 61–70, continuous at 60 (33.93B total XP for 1→70)
changes.before: 80 × 1.30^(L-1) for all 70 levels (19.41B total XP for 1→70)
changes.note: Endgame levels take ~75% more XP; the early game is untouched.

changes.after: 10 × 1.12^stage (≈192.43M per kill at stage 148 — about 176 kills for 1→70)
changes.before: 10 × 1.15^stage (≈9.62B per kill at stage 148 — about 2 kills for 1→70)
changes.note: Farming high stages no longer skips the climb.

changes.after: Capped at +50% inside XP gains (tooltips still show the true total)
changes.before: Uncapped — a Super Galaxy xpBonus pick gave +600% XP (7× leveling speed)
changes.note: Forged gear stays overpowered for combat, just not for leveling.

changes.after: Each rebirth multiplies all XP requirements ×1.35 (×1.35 at 1 rebirth, ×1.82 at 2)
changes.before: Reset to level 1 with identical XP costs every climb
changes.note: The multiplier is shown in the Rebirth panel. The server recomputes XP needs from level + rebirth count and ignores client-supplied values.

changes.after: Guild level capped at 20 (+40% XP max)
changes.note: Ships with the guild rework; bounds the biggest XP accelerator.
